The evidence is supported by the presence of overlapping indications, but the exact mechanism of action or clinical relevance remains uncertain. The findings highlight the potential for Tretamine to be considered in the treatment of Familial Ovarian Cancer, though further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety in this context.
